channel.title: Comments for page "The Great Short Story Contest Archives"
channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "The Great Short Story Contest Archives"

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: Here. A new round is open, it seems — March 1 to 31. Prompt: "SCPs at War".

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: I apologize for not voting in this contest, but I didn't have nearly enough votes to vote for all the awesome stories. Seriously, you guys (and gals) all rock.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
*brofists with Nioki* WOOHOO! SILVER MEDAL CLUB!

Seriously, though: thanks to all who voted for me, and thanks for the folks who put in all the hard work running this contest! And a hearty congratulations to all the other winners, especially Gears.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Wow. I certainly wasn't expecting that! I'm honored. Earnest thanks to all who voted for me!

Congratulations, as well, to the other winners. Excellent work, guys.

And last but by no means least, congratulations & thanks to everyone who entered. There was a lot of good work here — a lot of talent. My hat's off to you.

Also, the contest's continuance makes me happy. Let's get writing!

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: I would like to extend a hearty congratulations to the winners and a grand job to all the entries. By actually writing something to submit, you have proven more dedication to this site then quite a few others.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Don't feel ashamed or embarrassed, Gears. It was a fine story, and it deserved to win. I voted for it over my own entry, after all. It was worthy.

And no, I'm not bothered in the slightest that I apparently received no votes. Considering the competition, I regretted only having five votes, and had to winnow them tightly to make sure that I didn't waste one.

Congratulations to all of the winners!

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Goddammit. Sorry to all the new people who were in here, I honestly meant to slip in the back and just sort of sit in on the contest. I keep forgetting that, at least here, I enjoy a certain celebrity. Congrats to everyone who entered, thanks so much for putting forth the effort!

Thank you, as well, to everyone who voted for me. I was very worried that the story wouldn't be quite up to snuff, and I appreciate all the feedback I've gotten, both good and bad.

Err…I have no idea what the prize may actually be, but if it's just the knowledge that I can still crank out a good story or two, that's good enough.
